# typesense_conversation_model (Resource)

A conversation model configures Typesense's RAG-style conversational search. References an external LLM (OpenAI, Cloudflare, vLLM) and the Typesense collection that stores chat history.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "typesense_conversation_model" "rag" {
  model_name         = "openai/gpt-4"
  history_collection = typesense_collection.conversations.name
  api_key            = var.openai_api_key
  max_bytes          = 16384
  system_prompt      = "Answer based on the provided documents."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `history_collection` (String) Name of the Typesense collection that stores conversation history.
- `max_bytes` (Number) Maximum bytes to include in each LLM call context window.
- `model_name` (String) LLM model name (e.g. `openai/gpt-4`, `cloudflare/@cf/meta/llama-2-7b-chat-int8`).

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) LLM provider account ID (Cloudflare only).
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the upstream LLM provider.
- `system_prompt` (String)
- `ttl` (Number) Seconds after which chat history entries are deleted. Default: 86400 (24h).
- `vllm_url` (String) URL of a self-hosted vLLM service.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import typesense_conversation_model.rag <conversation-model-id>
```
